description: Election Commission - Order to appoint Mr.  Kuda Bandara Medawela as a member of the Uva Province Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the Uva Province Provincial Council due to the death of a member. It details the process of nominating a new member (Mr. Kuda Bandara Medawela) and his subsequent declaration as elected by the Election Commission. The content is entirely focused on electoral processes and procedures as outlined in the Provincial Councils Elections Act, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette.
